notes.title: Price reduced to $1
notes.content:
The price reduction should be approved by valve soon. It will remain this cheap while I work on the first major content update.

Cheers.

notes.title: Aliens Are Rude! small patch
notes.content:
Notes:

-Fixed soundtracks overlaying when transitioning between endgame scenes

-Added a tip at the begging of the game in regards to ability key-bind location and learning abilities from enemies.

notes.title: Aliens Are Rude Version 0.2
notes.content:
Notes:

-Added Frame slow and death animation to the players ship

-Added dpad for player movement on the controller

-modified collision masks on platforming component to make them more forgiving

-Added an alert to the upgraded eye monsters to notify the player they are about to spit.

Kind regards,
-David Ruttan
